[[File:Rune platelegs detail.png|left|90px]]
'''Rune platelegs''' are platelegs made of [[runite]]. They require level 40 [[Defence]] to wear. Rune platelegs are identical in function to the [[rune plateskirt]], but is 1kg heavier. Players may receive these from the [[crystal chest]] if they are a body type A character.

They can be created with the [[Smithing]] [[skill]] by using 3 [[runite bar]]s and a [[hammer]] on an [[anvil]]; this requires level 99 Smithing and yields 225 Smithing [[experience]].

Along with the rune plateskirt and [[Rune 2h sword|two-handed sword]], this is the best bar-per-alch item in the game. If smithing for money, rune platelegs, plateskirt and two-handed sword will give the best value for each bar.

They can also be put into the [[Nest (nice)|nest]] found on top of the [[Aldarin]] [[windmill]] in [[Varlamore]] in order to get a runite bar.
